name: Penalty kill
caption: You are killing a penalty, 4 on 5. Their D has the puck at the {side} point and their forwards are set up on the half-walls and at the net front.

questions.prompt: You are the forward on the right of the box. Tap where you should be.
questions.label: Pressure the point

fb.right: Top of the box on the puck side: close enough to pressure the point man and take away his shot, with your stick in the seam to the half-wall.
fb.close: Close. A few feet higher and toward the puck; a passive box gives their point man all day.
fb.wrong: On the kill you stay in the box: you are the top forward on the puck side. Get up toward the point man and take his shooting lane, not down to the net.

plan.label: Top of the box, puck side

questions.prompt: You are the forward on the right of the box. Tap where you should be.
questions.label: Hold the box

fb.right: Right. On the weak side you hold your corner of the box, cheating toward the slot, so the cross-ice pass to the back door is not a one-timer.
fb.close: Nearly. Stay a touch more central; your job on the weak side is the seam through the slot, not the far point.
fb.wrong: The puck is on the far point. You hold your corner of the box and cheat to the middle, so the seam pass across cannot become a one-timer.

plan.label: Top of the box, slot side
